deviation_mechanism: The lack of tight clustering in layers 19-21 stems from low optical sensitivity in the buffer/cladding bands. In this TMM stack, thickness perturbations of ±20 nm in those index positions shift the spectral response by less than the detection threshold, producing a near-flat Jacobian. Consequently, the stochastic optimizer retains diverse thickness trials in those coordinates without penalty, whereas layers 0-3 (which govern primary resonance coupling) exhibit steep objective gradients and naturally converge.
